opening.argument: The video presents Polygon as a gameplay review, not a transaction. The gunsmith screen likewise displays a weapon preview and attachment options. Those details support a showcase focused on how the game plays and what it offers. The recommendation to try it is paired with its free-to-play status, and the creator states that they are not affiliated or sponsored. There is no observed request for payment, credentials, or investment participation, nor a deceptive benefit flow.
